articles.title: Amazon cargo plane pilots may have considered aborting landing, NTSB says
articles.summary: Federal investigators say flight data suggests the pilots of the Amazon cargo plane may have attempted a go-around moments before the deadly crash.
articles.body:
Federal investigators said Sept. 8 that flight recorder data from an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane suggests the pilots may have considered aborting the landing moments before the aircraft crashed at Miami International Airport , killing five people on the ground.

The crash happened shortly before 2 p.m. on Sept. 6. The Amazon Air Flight 7598, a Boeing 767-33A operated by 21 Air LLC, arrived from San Juan, Puerto Rico, and overran the runway , leaving a crash path of 1,300 feet beyond the paved runway in a scene described as "utter devastation" by National Transportation Safety Board Chair Jennifer Homendy.

Five people were killed , all occupants of two vehicles, a van owned by a contract cleaning company for airlines and another vehicle, according to Homendy. Miami-Dade Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz said five others were taken to hospitals, including two pilots on board the plane who were treated and have since been released.

During a news conference Sept. 8, NTSB investigator Chihoon Shin said flight data showed the aircraft's nose landing gear and right main landing gear touched down about 30 seconds before the recording ended. The left main landing gear touched down about 19 seconds before the end of the recording.

Then a few seconds later, the brakes were released and the throttles were increased to "values consistent with go-around thrust," according to Shin. He added that there was no indication in the recorded data that speed brakes or thrust reversers were deployed.

"When we analyze the full list of parameters, we'll have a better idea of the aircraft performance during this landing. Was it normal? Was it not? And what was working and what was not?" Shin said.

Amazon Air cargo plane overruns Miami runway, killing 5 in crash

A view of an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane that airport officials said overran a runway at Miami International Airport, in Miami, Fla. on Sept. 6, 2026.

NTSB investigators to interview pilots of Amazon Prime Air cargo plane

Homendy said investigators plan to interview both pilots on Sept. 9 before releasing a summary of the cockpit voice recorder, which captured more than two hours of audio. The flight data recorder contained about 55 hours of data and recorded more than 400 aircraft parameters.

"We want to hear their account of the accident before we release a readout of the cockpit voice recorder," Homendy said during the news conference.

The NTSB also released information on the pilots' experience. Earlier on Sept. 8, local authorities identified the pilots as First Officer Jaime Felipe Silva Molina, 37, and Capt. Joseph Carol, 55.

According to Class 1 medical records cited by Homendy, Carol had logged 7,145 flight hours as of March, while Molina had logged 2,655 hours as of August.

The Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office identified the five people who were killed and the five who were injured in the Amazon Air cargo plane crash in an update on Sept. 8.

Ridoel Averhoff Diaz, 32, occupant of van

Roosevelt Sebastian Perdomo Torres, 36, occupant of van

Three victims remain hospitalized, including two in critical condition and one who is stable, Cordero-Stutz said.

The van was a 2012 Ford Econoline owned by Professional Ocean Service Corp., which was carrying seven employees. It was inside airport property at the time of the crash.

The other vehicle hit was a Toyota Corolla Cross, which was traveling outside of the airport's perimeter fence.

The NTSB's investigation remains ongoing. Homendy said investigators spent Sept. 8 documenting the crash scene, measuring runway and tire marks, collecting debris and examining the aircraft.

The aircraft departed with a takeoff weight of 252,182 pounds and was expected to land at 231,236 pounds, according to Homendy. The plane's cargo weighed 32,222 pounds and consisted primarily of contact lenses.

Investigators said no hazardous materials were aboard.

The cargo plane was on its third flight of the day, Homendy previously said. It had flown from Cincinnati to Miami, and from Miami to San Juan, earlier on Sept. 6 before the crash.

More than 60 rescue units and about 200 emergency personnel responded to the crash, working to free trapped occupants of the vehicles and plane, as airplane fuel leaked for hours. The plane was also engulfed in flames.

The incident prompted the airport to close two of its four runways. Though the airport stopped all flights immediately after the crash, flights had resumed by the evening of Sept. 6.

By the evening of Sept. 8, Homendy said one runway was reopened for "departures in the easterly direction."
authors: Jeanine Santucci and Thao Nguyen, USA TODAY

articles.title: Swansea man who 'should be dead' reunites with teacher who changed his life
articles.summary: Sam Gardner was in foster care when he met a teacher who made him believe in himself.
articles.body:
"Statistically I should be dead, in prison or homeless."

Sam Gardner lived in 15 foster homes between the ages of three and 17, and said the instability was a "big challenge".

He never felt at home anywhere and was sometimes hungry and neglected. When he left the care system at 18, his future was uncertain.

But he said a few "anchors" helped him to lay the foundations for adulthood. Now, the BBC has helped to reunite the 33-year-old with one of them - his former teacher who "saw past" Sam being a child in foster care.

"She made me feel like I belonged," said Sam, who went on to become a teacher himself.

Sam said he didn't really feel at home until he met his last set of foster carers, when he was aged 17.

Despite his start in life, Sam defied the odds to become a primary school teacher, inspired by one special woman who he said believed in him at his school in south Wales.

"She wasn't a perfect teacher but she saw past my label as a looked-after child. She also demanded that I didn't look at that label," recalled Sam.

He said before joining Christine Meek's class aged eight, school was a "challenging place" and that he was academically two years behind his peers.

Sam's story of hope comes after a recent report found young care leavers in England are dying at a far higher rate than other people their age.

BBC Wales reunited Ms Meek and Sam at St Michael's Catholic Primary School in Pontypridd, where she first taught him 25 years ago.

"I just want to say you've changed my life, I wouldn't be where I am without you," said Sam, as he hugged Ms Meek.

She replied: "It's you who should be proud of what you've done, because it's you who has done it."

Ms Meek described Sam as "quiet" in school "but that he also tested boundaries".

"I didn't know a lot about Sam's background and in some ways I think that helps," she said.

"The expectations were the same for everyone in the class."

Ms Meek said it was a pleasure to hear what Sam had gone on to achieve in his life.

"As a teacher you plant seeds, you don't know what they're going to grow and that's a lovely thing," she added.

Sam said: "Walking back through those doors as the person I am today, I realised just how much of St Michael's I'd carried with me.

"My childhood involved so much change, but that school gave me something steady to stand on."

He said it was emotional being back, and a privilege to catch up with Ms Meek.

"Ms Meek and the other adults there planted seeds in me that I probably couldn't see at the time, but they became part of the foundation I grew from," he said.

Sam, who now lives in Swansea, has recently been looking through his care files and shared an excerpt with the BBC.

"Sadly there has been a great deterioration in Sam's behaviour at school and he is the cause of much concern," one read. "His class teacher is emotionally drained. He is disruptive, erratic and volatile."

Sam said it had been "overwhelming" reading about his childhood in the files.

With Ms Meek as his teacher, Sam was able to improve and meet school grade expectations.

"I was able to believe in myself because of the foundation she created," he recalled.

"She made me feel like I belonged and because of that I was able to achieve my potential."

Sam said he had more than 50 professionals in his life, and having "anchors" who supported him was vital.

It is estimated there are currently around 7,000 children in foster care in Wales and 54,000 in England, according to government data.

A UK government-commissioned review found young care leavers in England were dying at a far higher rate than other people their age, with the report co-author calling the deaths "a national tragedy" .

"The corporate parent is meant to be your parent," said Sam. "What kind of parent allows that to happen to their children? We need to wake up.

"The hardest part of being in foster care is the transitions, moving from home to home, often with your stuff in black bags.

"It signals that you're different, that you don't belong, you're not valued."

Sam's reunion comes after Foster Wales launched a pilot across 37 schools in Swansea and Neath Port Talbot in May, with the aim of connecting local authority fostering services directly with schools.

"We talk a lot about the power of one caring adult in a child's life, and that could be a teacher or member of staff within the school," said Alistair Cope, head of Foster Wales.

"It's been fantastic to see Sam sharing the importance of that, he's a phenomenal individual for telling his story."

It is hoped the pilot will improve the support offered to children in care, so they can thrive in an educational environment.

Sketty Primary School in Swansea is one of those taking part in the pilot.

"We are lucky to have such strong networks of care and support around our children - and this initiative helps shine a light on that," said headteacher Simon Lloyd-Jones.

"It also highlights the way schools go above and beyond to support some of our most vulnerable learners, including looked-after children, helping them feel safe, valued and able to thrive."

Sam left teaching last year to work as a keynote speaker and trainer drawing on his lived experiences.

He said it was his role to "speak up in rooms for children who can't always speak up for themselves".

"My role isn't to call foster carers out, call the system out on what they've done wrong and how it's affected me and my life.

"It's more to show the impact we can have on thousands of children in this country," said Sam.

"Children in care experience instability on another level, and that's often misunderstood, so the more we can understand the better we can provide the support they need."

The Welsh government said it "recognises the concerns raised" by people who have been in care.

"Sustained support for care leavers is vital, particularly as they transition into adulthood," their statement added.

If you or someone you know has been affected by the issues raised in this story, information about available help and support can be found via BBC Action Line .

articles.title: Freezer explode e provoca incêndio em churrascaria de Vitória | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o proprietário, o equipamento explodiu em uma copa do restaurante, no bairro Jardim Camburi. Ninguém ficou ferido.
articles.summary: Segundo o proprietário, o equipamento explodiu em uma copa do restaurante, no bairro Jardim Camburi. Ninguém ficou ferido.
articles.body:
Um incêndio atingiu uma churrascaria no bairro Jardim Camburi, em Vitória, no começo da manhã desta quarta-feira (9). Segundo o proprietário do restaurante, Wilson Dreyer, as chamas começaram depois que um freezer explodiu. O estabelecimento não estava funcionando no momento e ninguém ficou ferido.

Quem passou pelo local, por volta das 6h, registrou o momento em que era possível ver as chamas da calçada do restaurante. Uma fumaça preta também saía pelo telhado. (assista acima)

“Foi um susto muito grande, o alarme disparou, eu moro ao lado, dei uma olhadinha para baixo, pensei que fosse serração do tempo, mas quando fui ver era fumaça, realmente era um incêndio”, disse o dono do restaurante, Wilson Dreyer.

De acordo com o proprietário, pessoas que passavam pelo local perceberam o incêndio, pularam o muro do estabelecimento e ajudaram a controlar as chamas com extintores antes da chegada do Corpo de Bombeiros.

Freezer explode e provoca incêndio em churrascaria de Vitória, Espírito Santo — Foto: TV Gazeta

“Quando cheguei aqui, já tinha gente pulando o muro já com o extintor na mão. Quando os bombeiros chegaram, a situação já estava controlada. Hoje eu vi que tem gente que a gente precisa priorizar muito na vida”, disse.

O freezer ficava em uma copa do restaurante. Após o controle do incêndio, o equipamento foi encontrado destruído. Também havia fuligem e partes do forro do teto derretidas. A estrutura do estabelecimento, no entanto, foi preservada.

“Eu procuro deixar as coisas muito em dia, realmente foi um acidente. Trabalhamos muito no final de semana, estava tudo certo. Tenho muito cuidado em termos das churrasqueira, da cozinha, mas nunca imaginei que poderia ter um acidente desse na copa”, lamentou.

A churrascaria costuma funcionar para almoço e jantar. Por causa do incêndio, o estabelecimento deve abrir somente a partir das 16h nesta quarta-feira.

“O que aconteceu prejudica um pouco a nossa rotina mas está tudo em paz. Foi um transtorno, mas, pelo que vejo podia ter sido muito pior”.

Após o incêndio, o proprietário também avalia reduzir de 10 para seis o número de freezers no estabelecimento.

O Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado, esteve no local e realizou o combate final ao incêndio. As causas do incêndio não foram comentadas oficialmente e nem se houve o pedido de perícia.

articles.title: Plaza Residence chega a Rio Preto unindo localização, arquitetura e praticidade | G1
articles.standfirst: Plaza Residence da R3M no Plaza Avenida Shopping traz novo conceito de moradia e investimento, oferecendo plantas de 50 m², 74 m² e junções de 100 m² a 148 m².
articles.summary: Plaza Residence da R3M no Plaza Avenida Shopping traz novo conceito de moradia e investimento, oferecendo plantas de 50 m², 74 m² e junções de 100 m² a 148 m².
articles.body:
O Plaza Residence será integrado ao complexo Plaza Avenida Shopping, em uma das regiões mais valorizadas da zona sul de São José do Rio Preto — Foto: R3M/Divulgação

A escolha de um imóvel vai além da metragem ou da arquitetura. Cada vez mais, fatores como localização, mobilidade e praticidade têm peso na decisão de compra . Estar próximo ao trabalho, aos serviços, ao lazer e aos principais pontos da cidade tornou-se um diferencial importante para quem busca qualidade de vida.

Assim, a R3M apresenta o Plaza Residence , novo empreendimento residencial em São José do Rio Preto.

Integrado ao complexo Plaza Avenida Shopping , o empreendimento reúne arquitetura contemporânea, localização estratégica e plantas desenvolvidas para atender diferentes perfis de moradores . O projeto foi concebido tanto para quem busca um novo lugar para morar quanto para quem procura um imóvel com potencial de valorização.

Antes do Plaza Residence , a R3M já havia desenvolvido o Plaza Corporate , edifício comercial localizado no mesmo complexo. Agora, amplia sua atuação na região com um empreendimento residencial voltado às novas formas de viver e investir.

Localizado em uma das regiões mais valorizadas da zona sul de São José do Rio Preto, o Plaza Residence oferece acesso facilitado ao Plaza Avenida Shopping, além de restaurantes, supermercados, academias, serviços e importantes vias da cidade .

Na prática, isso representa mais conveniência para o dia a dia. A proximidade com diferentes serviços reduz deslocamentos e contribui para uma rotina mais prática.

Além da localização, o empreendimento aposta em um conceito que acompanha as transformações do mercado imobiliário. O projeto oferece apartamentos com possibilidade de junção de plantas, permitindo configurações maiores e metragens superiores à média encontrada no mercado, além de uma arquitetura planejada para integrar funcionalidade e conforto .

Plantas desenvolvidas para diferentes estilos de vida

O Plaza Residence oferece apartamentos de 50 m² e 74 m² , com plantas projetadas para aproveitar melhor os ambientes e atender múltiplas necessidades. O empreendimento oferece também a possibilidade de unificação de unidades, permitindo configurações ainda mais amplas e adaptadas a diferentes estilos de vida, com sugestão de plantas que podem variar de aproximadamente 100 a 148 m² .

As opções contemplam desde pessoas que vivem sozinhas até casais e famílias que desejam mais espaço, sem abrir mão da praticidade.

Outro destaque é a arquitetura contemporânea, que combina funcionalidade, elegância e integração entre os espaços.

Além dos apartamentos, o empreendimento contará com áreas comuns desenvolvidas para acompanhar o estilo de vida contemporâneo.

Academia, coworking, piscina coberta aquecida e espaços de convivência fazem parte da estrutura planejada para os moradores — Foto: R3M/Divulgação

Entre os ambientes previstos estão academia, coworking, lavanderia compartilhada, terraço, piscina coberta aquecida e espaços de convivência . A proposta é oferecer uma infraestrutura que contribua para uma rotina mais prática e confortável.

Essa combinação entre localização, serviços e infraestrutura também torna o empreendimento atrativo para investidores que buscam imóveis em regiões consolidadas e alinhados às novas demandas do mercado.

A valorização da zona sul de São José do Rio Preto, somada à integração com o Plaza Avenida Shopping , posiciona o Plaza Residence entre os novos empreendimentos da cidade voltados para um público que busca mobilidade, conveniência e qualidade de vida.

As plantas foram desenvolvidas para atender diferentes perfis de moradores, unindo arquitetura contemporânea e funcionalidade — Foto: R3M/Divulgação

Para quem pretende morar, o empreendimento reúne localização estratégica, mobilidade e infraestrutura planejada para facilitar a rotina . Já para quem deseja investir, apresenta características valorizadas pelo mercado, como localização consolidada, arquitetura contemporânea e um conceito alinhado às transformações no comportamento de consumo imobiliário .

Segundo a R3M , o Plaza Residence foi concebido para acompanhar uma nova forma de morar, conectando conveniência, mobilidade e qualidade de vida em um único endereço.

Para conhecer mais detalhes sobre o Plaza Residence e acompanhar as novidades do lançamento, acesse a página oficial do empreendimento: plazaresidence.r3me.com.br

articles.title: Mega-Sena: apostas da região ganham, juntas, R$ 139 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Ninguém acertou o prêmio principal, que acumulou em R$ 76 milhões.
articles.summary: Ninguém acertou o prêmio principal, que acumulou em R$ 76 milhões.
articles.body:
Três apostadores do Vale do Paraíba e região ficaram a um número de conquistar o prêmio milionário do concurso 3.055 da Mega-Sena , realizado na noite desta terça-feira (8).

De acordo com a Caixa Econômica Federal, ninguém acertou as seis dezenas sorteadas e o prêmio principal acumulou em R$ 76 milhões.

Se por um lado ninguém faturou o prêmio principal, apostadores do Vale do Paraíba chegaram muito perto de conquistar a bolada e faturaram, juntos, R$ 139.172,32 .

As apostas foram feitas em Guaratinguetá e em São José dos Campos . Em Guará, um bolão com 28 cotas faturou R$ 69.586,16. Ele foi feito na Lotérica Apolo XI, na região central da cidade.

Já em São José, duas apostas, registradas nas lotéricas Paraíso e Sul, ganharam R$ 34.793,08 cada. Elas foram simples, com seis números apostados.

O próximo sorteio da Mega-Sena está previsto para esta quinta-feira (10), no Espaço da Sorte, em São Paulo.

Bilhetes da Mega-Sena, em imagem de arquivo — Foto: Marcelo Brandt/G1

As apostas podem ser feitas até as 20h (horário de Brasília) do dia do sorteio, em qualquer lotérica do país ou pela internet, no site ou aplicativo da Caixa Econômica Federal.

É necessário ser maior de 18 anos e fazer um cadastro para realizar as apostas on-line.

A probabilidade de vencer na Mega-Sena varia de acordo com a quantidade de dezenas apostadas. Na aposta simples, com seis números e custo de R$ 6, a chance de acertar as seis dezenas é de uma em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

articles.title: Miss Áustria morre aos 22 anos | G1
articles.standfirst: Causa da morte de Lucia Sisic não foi revelada. Miss tinha problema cardíaco e passou por cirurgia em 2025. 'Nos deixou cedo demais', lamentou um amigo da família.
articles.summary: Causa da morte de Lucia Sisic não foi revelada. Miss tinha problema cardíaco e passou por cirurgia em 2025. 'Nos deixou cedo demais', lamentou um amigo da família.
articles.body:
Miss Áustria, Lucia Sisic, morreu aos 22 anos em 8 de setembro de 2026. — Foto: Reprodução/redes sociais

A atual Miss Áustria , Lucia Sisic, morreu aos 22 anos, informou na terça-feira (8) o Mission Austria, instituição responsável pelo concurso de beleza no país europeu.

"Com grande consternação e profunda tristeza, soubemos do falecimento de nossa Miss Áustria 2024, Lucia Sisic. Neste momento tão difícil, nossos pensamentos e nossa mais profunda solidariedade estão com sua família, seus amigos e todas as pessoas que lhe eram próximas", afirmou o Mission Austria em comunicado.

A causa da morte não havia sido divulgada oficialmente nem pela organização do concurso, nem pela família, nem por autoridades austríacas até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Segundo a mídia austríaca, Lucia tinha um defeito na válvula cardíaca desde seu nascimento e passou por sete cirurgias no coração , sendo a mais recente delas em setembro de 2025. Em uma publicação nas redes sociais em agosto de 2024, Lucia agradeceu sua equipe médica "por se empenharem tanto em salvar a minha vida" e dar-lhe "a oportunidade de viver uma vida plena".

"Nossa Lucia, você nos deixou cedo demais, mas a lembrança de você permanecerá para sempre conosco", afirmou Miroslav Piplica, descrito pela imprensa austríaca como um amigo próximo da família.

Lucia foi eleita Miss Áustria em 2024 e ela detinha o título desde então, porque o concurso de beleza não foi realizado nem em 2025 nem em 2026 por conta de falta de patrocinadores.

articles.title: Jovem de RO morto no Ceará sonhava em ser policial e ajudar família | G1
articles.standfirst: Natural de Rondônia, Herbert Douglas, de 23 anos, morava no Ceará para se preparar para o concurso da Polícia Militar. O jovem morreu na madrugada de domingo (6).
articles.summary: Herbert Douglas, jovem de RO morto no Ceará durante a ExpoIguatu, era ex-sargento e se preparava para o concurso da Polícia Militar para ajudar a família.
articles.body:
Herbert Douglas Oliveira da Silva, de 23 anos, morto após ser agredido durante a ExpoIguatu, no interior do Ceará, foi descrito pela família como um jovem tranquilo, dedicado aos estudos, à família e ao futebol. Natural de Rondônia, ele estava morando havia cerca de três meses em Iguatu (CE), onde se preparava para um concurso da Polícia Militar.

➡️ O jovem morreu na madrugada de domingo (6), após ser agredido durante uma briga generalizada na ExpoIguatu. Três homens foram presos em flagrante suspeitos de envolvimento na morte.

Para o irmão, Vitor Santos, Herbert era uma pessoa reservada e nunca havia se envolvido em problemas.

"Meu irmão, como pessoa, ele sempre foi o mais quietinho. Nunca se envolveu com nada errado, era um bom aluno, um bom filho, nunca matou, nunca bateu, nunca humilhou, nunca fez nada com ninguém. Todo mundo gostava dele, aqui mesmo, todo mundo tá revoltado com essa história", contou.

Segundo Vitor, Herbert também era muito ligado aos avós, que ficaram abalados após a morte do neto. O jovem gostava de futebol e chegou a jogar em times de diferentes lugares, inclusive na Bolívia.

"Meu avô até agora está muito ruim e abalado demais, minha avó também. Ele jogava muito futebol, todo mundo jogava com ele, gostava dele. Ele participou de vários times, até na Bolívia já jogou. Jogava em vários times aqui da cidade", disse.

O pai de Herbert, João dos Santos da Silva, também descreveu o filho como uma pessoa querida e que fazia amizades por onde passava. Segundo ele, o jovem tinha uma trajetória ligada aos estudos, ao futebol e ao Exército, onde chegou à graduação de sargento.

"O Herbert foi um menino de ouro. Ele foi estudante, fez muita amizade, ele foi adolescente nos colégios, onde ele participou dos clubes de futebol. Ele jogava futebol aqui, jogava futebol lá na Bolívia. Ele foi do quartel, jogou futebol no quartel", disse.

João contou que o filho deixou Guajará-Mirim (RO) para tentar construir a própria vida no Ceará. Segundo ele, Herbert também queria estudar para ser policial militar.

"E ele foi daqui de Guajara-Mirim pra poder fazer a vida, porque aqui nós não temos oportunidade. Então ele foi pra lá, pro Ceará, pra fazer a vida dele", disse.

Herbert Douglas Oliveira da Silva — Foto: Reprodução/redes sociais

Vitor conta que o irmão tinha uma relação próxima com os familiares e fazia planos para ajudar a família. Segundo ele, o irmão sempre se preocupou em contribuir com a família e dar o melhor para os parentes.

"Ele sempre demonstrou que a família era o primeiro lugar. E pra ele, na cabeça dele, ele tinha que dar tudo, tinha que ser o rapaz que tinha que ajudar a família, que ia ter que dar tudo pra família", afirmou.

Ao falar sobre a morte do irmão, Vitor pediu que os responsáveis sejam punidos.

"Que essa justiça venha a ser feita. Meu irmão é um rapaz que de 0 a 10 ele mereceu uma nota maior do que 10, porque ele foi bom pra todo mundo, pra todos é isso", disse.

O corpo de Herbert será levado de Iguatu para Guajará-Mirim (RO), onde vivem a mãe e outros familiares. Segundo Vitor, o traslado iniciou na noite desta terça-feira (8), com previsão de chegada na manhã de quinta-feira (10).

Segundo o irmão, o velório será realizado na quinta-feira, mesmo dia em que o corpo deverá ser enterrado.

Herbert Douglas Oliveira da Silva, de 23 anos, foi linchado durante a ExpoIguatu , evento realizado em Iguatu, no interior do Ceará. A vítima era natural de Rondônia, mas estava morando provisoriamente no Ceará. O caso aconteceu na madrugada deste domingo (6). Três suspeitos foram presos em flagrante.

Vídeos feitos por testemunhas (veja acima) mostraram diferentes momentos da briga generalizada que terminou com a morte de Douglas. Nas imagens, seguranças, equipe de apoio e outros participantes apareceram agredindo o jovem.

Douglas estava com amigos no evento, que acontece no Parque de Exposições de Iguatu, quando se envolveu em uma briga com outros homens. Os seguranças, então, se aproximaram para intervir na briga. Devido às agressões, o jovem ainda foi levado a um hospital, mas não resistiu.

A Secretaria da Segurança Pública e Defesa Social informou que três homens, com idades de 21, 25 e 28 anos, foram presos em flagrante por suspeita de envolvimento na morte do jovem que foi gravemente lesionado.

Os suspeitos foram capturados pela Polícia Militar do Ceará (PMCE) e conduzidos à Delegacia de Polícia Civil de Iguatu, onde foram colocados à disposição da Justiça.

A ExpoIguatu é uma tradicional feira agropecuária realizada no município em parceria com a Prefeitura de Iguatu. Os cantores Jonas Esticado, Zé Cantor e Talita Mel se apresentaram no evento na noite de sábado (5).

O Rotary Club de Iguatu lamentou a morte, informou que a vítima foi socorrida após uma confusão no Parque de Exposições e afirmou que acompanha as investigações. O clube disse ainda que está à disposição das autoridades para ajudar no esclarecimento do caso.

A Prefeitura também lamentou a morte e afirmou que o evento era particular, organizado pelo Rotary Club em parceria com empresas de produção, e contava com segurança privada. Disse que acompanha as investigações e espera a responsabilização dos envolvidos.

articles.standfirst: Benefício é voltado a imóveis com medidas sustentáveis, como captação de água, energia solar e calçada verde. Requerimento deve ser feito na Secretaria do Meio Ambiente, até o dia 30 de setembro.
articles.summary: Moradores de Avaré podem obter desconto de até 15% no IPTU de 2027 ao adotarem medidas sustentáveis. O benefício deve ser solicitado até 30 de setembro.
articles.body:
Vista aérea de Avaré, no interior de São Paulo — Foto: Foto: Divulgação/Buskaza

Os moradores de Avaré (SP) que adotam medidas de sustentabilidade nos imóveis podem obter um desconto de até 15% no Imposto Predial e Territorial Urbano (IPTU) de 2027. A medida pode ser solicitada até o dia 30 de setembro, na Secretaria do Meio Ambiente.

Segundo a prefeitura, benefício é concedido por meio do programa IPTU Verde e exige o cumprimento de uma série de critérios ambientais estabelecidos pela lei. Entre eles, está a comprovação de alguma solução ecológica no imóvel e respeitar o prazo para o pedido. Veja a lista completa:

Sistema de captação e reúso de água de chuva;

Aquecimento de água por sistema solar, hidráulico ou elétrico eficiente;

Implantação de calçada verde (com área permeável e vegetação);

Utilização de materiais sustentáveis na construção original do imóvel ou em reformas e ampliações.

A análise e decisão são de responsabilidade da secretaria, que emite um parecer após vistoriar o imóvel e checar se ele cumpre os requisitos exigidos.

Durante o cadastro, o morador deve preencher um requerimento detalhando todos os dispositivos ecológicos implantados na propriedade e apresentar os documentos que comprovem a instalação. O solicitante deve estar em dia com todas as suas obrigações tributárias municipais.

A Secretaria Municipal do Meio Ambiente fica localizada na Rua Pernambuco, s/n, no Horto Florestal.

articles.title: MP aciona empresas suspeitas de intermediar apostas ilegais na BA | G1
articles.standfirst: Órgão pede bloqueio de bens no total de R$ 5 milhões, além do fim das atividades das empresas.
articles.summary: Órgão pede bloqueio de bens no total de R$ 5 milhões, além do fim das atividades das empresas
articles.body:
MP-BA aciona empresas por suspeita de intermediação de apostas ilegais após cliente denunciar golpe de mais de R$ 100 mil — Foto: Magnific

O Ministério Público da Bahia (MP-BA) ajuizou uma ação civil pública contra três empresas por suspeita de intermediação de apostas online ilegais.

Segundo o órgão, a medida foi tomada após um cliente denunciar ter sido vítima de um golpe que gerou um prejuízo de mais de R$ 100 mil. As informações foram divulgadas na terça-feira (8).

As empresas foram identificadas como Nuoro Pay Instituição de Pagamento Ltda., Select Credit Sociedade de Crédito ao Microempreendedor e a Empresa de Pequeno Porte Ltda., e Cartos Sociedade de Crédito Direto S.A.

O g1 tentou contato com as organizações, mas não tinha conseguido retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Segundo a promotora de Justiça Joseane Suzart, autora da ação, as duas primeiras empresas teriam realizado a intermediação de pagamentos para casas de apostas não autorizadas, sem adotar diligências consideradas necessárias para verificar a idoneidade das empresas beneficiárias e sem monitorar adequadamente transações atípicas.

Já a terceira empresa, por sua vez, teria disponibilizado tecnologia e infraestrutura para viabilizar a intermediação de pagamentos junto à Nuoro Pay.

No suposto esquema, conforme a promotora, as plataformas de apostas não receberiam diretamente os valores dos jogadores. Segundo os elementos reunidos no inquérito, seriam utilizadas empresas intermediadoras de pagamento e empresas receptoras para movimentar os recursos, dificultando a identificação dos destinatários finais.

O documento também aponta que, em determinados comprovantes de transferência, o nome das plataformas de apostas não aparecia.

Ainda segundo a investigação, foram identificadas situações consideradas incompatíveis com operações financeiras regulares, como empresas recém-constituídas, endereços repetidos, documentos com indícios de edição e alterações sucessivas de composição societária.

Além de procurar o MP-BA, o denunciante também encaminhou informações sobre o caso ao Ministério da Fazenda, Conselho de Controle de Atividades Financeiras (Coaf), Banco Central, Ministério Público do Paraná, Receita Federal e Polícia Federal (PF).

Durante a investigação, o órgão fez um levantamento em plataformas de reclamação de consumidores. Em consulta realizada em julho de 2025, foram identificados 1.536 registros relacionados à Nuoro Pay, classificados, entre outros temas, como pedidos de estorno de valores, consultoria financeira e reclamações sobre problemas não solucionados.

O documento registra ainda relatos de golpes e fraudes financeiras envolvendo jogos e apostas.

Na ação, o MP-BA pede o bloqueio de bens, direitos e ativos financeiros das empresas e de seus sócios até o limite de R$ 5 milhões, com o objetivo de assegurar eventual execução de obrigações de pagamento decorrentes da ação.

No pedido definitivo, o órgão requer a desconsideração da personalidade jurídica das três empresas, com a inclusão dos respectivos sócios, além do encerramento definitivo das atividades da Nuoro Pay, Select Credit e Cartos.

A ação ainda requer que as empresas sejam obrigadas a adotar mecanismos de controle das transações, incluindo consulta à relação de operadores de apostas autorizados e não autorizados pela Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas do Ministério da Fazenda.

articles.title: Polo eleitoral de Itaperuna recebe 951 urnas para eleições na região | G1
articles.standfirst: Equipamentos estão sendo preparados e carregados. Eleitores de Itaperuna precisam ficar atentos a mudanças nos locais de votação.
articles.summary: Equipamentos estão sendo preparados e carregados. Eleitores de Itaperuna precisam ficar atentos a mudanças nos locais de votação.
articles.body:
O polo eleitoral de Itaperuna , que atende além de Itaperuna, os municípios de Santo Antônio de Pádua , Aperibé , Natividade , Varre-Sai , Porciúncula , Bom Jesus do Itabapoana , Cambuci , Itaocara e Miracema , no Noroeste Fluminense, recebeu 951 urnas eletrônicas que serão utilizadas nas eleições de 2026.

Os equipamentos já chegaram ao local e agora passam pelos procedimentos de preparação, como limpeza e carregamento.

Os eleitores de Itaperuna também devem ficar atentos a mudanças nos locais de votação. Ao todo, sete locais de votação, pertencentes à 107ª Zona Eleitoral, foram alterados para as eleições de 2026 ( veja ao final da reportagem ).

Itaperuna recebeu 951 urnas eleitorais — Foto: Divulgação

Escola Municipal Vereador Elzo Galvão da França: as três seções que funcionavam no local foram transferidas para a Fundação Educacional e Cultural São José.

Escola Municipal Humberto de Campos: o local de votação foi transferido para o Jardim de Infância Prof.ª Maria Madalena Magacho. No novo endereço serão instaladas seis seções, sendo quatro em espaço com acessibilidade.

Escola Municipal Lincoln Barbosa de Castro: o local de votação foi transferido para a Vara do Trabalho de Itaperuna (VT01ITP). O novo endereço receberá quatro seções, sendo duas no terceiro andar, com acessibilidade, e duas no segundo andar.

Escola Municipal Oscar Jerônimo: as seções 161, 174 e 199, que funcionavam na unidade, passarão a funcionar na Escola Municipal Coronel José Cardoso.

Colégio Estadual Nicolau Bastos Filho, em Comendador Venâncio: as seções 100, 101, 102, 103 e 122 passarão a funcionar na Escola Municipal Comendador Venâncio.

Posto de Saúde da Vila Mangueira, em São José de Ubá: as seções 275 e 286 passarão a funcionar no Colégio Municipal Antônio Curty, no Barro Branco.

Colégio Estadual Dr. José Bastos França, em Raposo: as seções que funcionavam na unidade passarão a funcionar no Colégio Municipal Santa Paz.

A Justiça Eleitoral também prevê a manutenção do Colégio Estadual Romualdo Monteiro de Barros como local de votação.

As alterações nos locais de votação têm caráter provisório. Conforme as informações divulgadas pela Justiça Eleitoral, está prevista a reversão das mudanças em novembro de 2026, com a reabertura do cadastro eleitoral.

Os eleitores devem conferir antecipadamente o local de votação para saber se houve mudança e evitar deslocamentos para o endereço antigo no dia da eleição.

articles.title: Novenário de São Vicente de Paulo em Petrolina: veja a programação | G1
articles.standfirst: Celebrações na comunidade do Alto do Cocar seguem até o dia 19 de setembro. Encerramento contará com tradicional procissão, missa e quermesse.
articles.summary: O Novenário de São Vicente de Paulo em Petrolina começa nesta quarta (9) no Alto do Cocar. A festa segue até dia 19 com missas, procissão e quermesse.
articles.body:
Começa nesta quarta-feira (9) o novenário em honra a São Vicente de Paulo na capela da comunidade do Alto do Cocar, em Petrolina , no Sertão de Pernambuco. A programação segue até 19 de setembro com momentos de oração, novenas e celebrações eucarísticas.

Diariamente, a programação conta com o santo terço às 18h30, a novena às 19h e a santa missa às 19h30. O encerramento será no dia 19 de setembro, com a tradicional procissão, missa e quermesse.

Abertura – 9 de setembro A abertura do novenário acontece na quarta-feira (9). A animação será realizada pelo Coral Luz Divina, e a santa missa está marcada para as 19h30. A quermesse terá como atração Genário de Carvalho e Romário.

1ª noite – 10 de setembro Na primeira noite, os noiteiros serão as ruas 17, 18 e 19; a comunidade São José Pedro (Pedro Raimundo); Terra da Liberdade; e o Assentamento Mandacaru. A animação ficará por conta do Coral São Pedro.

2ª noite – 11 de setembro A segunda noite terá como noiteiros as ruas 20, 21 e 22; a Pastoral da Acolhida; a UBS do Alto do Cocar; a comunidade Santo Antônio, do Jardim São Paulo; a comunidade Santo André, do Ipsep II; a paróquia Nossa Senhora do Rosário, de São Gonçalo; e os Filhos da Misericórdia. A animação será do Coral Luz Divina.

3ª noite – 12 de setembro Na terceira noite, participam como noiteiros as ruas 23, 24 e 25; a Creche Nossa Infância Marília de Castro; a Unidade Mundo Feliz; a comunidade Nossa Senhora de Fátima, do Quati; e a Legião de Maria. A animação será do Coral Nossa Senhora de Fátima.

4ª noite – 13 de setembro A quarta noite terá como noiteiros as ruas 26 e 27; a Rua do Milho; os Homens do Terço; o OVS; e a comunidade da área São Sebastião. A animação ficará por conta do Ministério da Profecia.

5ª noite – 14 de setembro Na quinta noite, os noiteiros serão as ruas 31 e 32; a paróquia Santa Rita de Cássia; o grupo de Nossa Senhora do Perpétuo Socorro; o Colégio Júlia Elisa; e a Pastoral Familiar. A animação será realizada pelo coral da Pastoral Familiar.

6ª noite – 15 de setembro A sexta noite terá como noiteiros as ruas 33, 34 e 35; a Pastoral do Dízimo; a Catequese; as Mães que Oram pelos Filhos; a comunidade Santa Paulina, de Pedra Linda; a paróquia São Paulo Apóstolo, de Areia Branca; e a paróquia Santa Luzia, da Cohab Massangano. A animação será do Coral São Paulo.

7ª noite – 16 de setembro Na sétima noite, participam as ruas 36, 37 e 38; a paróquia São Francisco de Assis; o Coral Santa Clara; o Apostolado do Sagrado Coração de Jesus; e o Coral Amiguinhos de Jesus, do Jardim Amazonas. A animação será do Coral Santa Clara.

8ª noite – 17 de setembro A oitava noite terá como noiteiros as ruas do Jardim Brasília; ministros; acólitos; vicentinos; Pascom; jovens; e a área de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, no Cosme e Damião. A animação será do Coral Ágape.

9ª noite – 18 de setembro Na nona e última noite do novenário, antes do encerramento, os noiteiros serão o Círculo Bíblico São Lucas; as ruas do Parque São Paulo; a paróquia Nossa Senhora das Dores, de Ouro Preto; e a paróquia São João Batista, de João de Deus. A animação ficará por conta do Coral Nossa Senhora das Dores.

Encerramento – 19 de setembro O encerramento do novenário acontece no sábado (19). A programação começa com a procissão, com saída às 18h30. Em seguida, será celebrada a santa missa, às 19h30, com animação do Coral São Lucas. Para finalizar a festa, a quermesse terá como atração Marques do Forró.

Imagem divulgada pelas forças Houthi, em 7 de setembro, supostamente mostra um ataque com míssil balístico contra caminhões que transportavam equipamentos militares da Arábia Saudita para campo militar no Iêmen. — Foto: Ansarullah Media Center via AFP

O grupo terrorista Houthi informou nesta quarta-feira (9) que mais de 30 ataques sauditas foram registrados em várias regiões do Iêmen , um dia após o grupo bombardear o território da Arábia Saudita , ações que deixaram dezenas de feridos.

"Aviões sauditas executaram 32 ataques aéreos contra diversas áreas das províncias de Marib, Al Jawf, Taiz e Hodeida nas últimas horas", informou o canal de televisão houthi Almasirah.

O ataque seria uma retaliação a uma série de bombardeios que os Houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, realizaram contra a Arábia Saudita na terça contra estruturas petrolíferas do país árabe. Na ocasião, o grupo terrorista iemenita também anunciou uma escalada contra os sauditas.

O governo saudita, que anteriormente havia prometido retaliação contra os Houthis, não havia se pronunciado de forma oficial sobre o ataque até a última atualização desta reportagem.

A escalada nos confrontos entre os Houthis e a Arábia Saudita decorre da guerra no Oriente Médio entre os Estados Unidos e o Irã. O grupo iemenita realiza um bloqueio marítimo aos sauditas desde julho, e recentemente escalou para ataques em terra.

articles.standfirst: Medida decorre de pressão de protestos estudantis. Novo pleito foi marcado para 25 de outubro, e presidente Aleksandar Vučić concorrerá ao cargo de premiê.
articles.summary: Medida decorre de pressão de protestos estudantis. Novo pleito foi marcado para 25 de outubro, e presidente Aleksandar Vučić concorrerá ao cargo de premiê.
articles.body:
Presidente da Sérvia, Aleksandar Vučić, anunciou que deixará o cargo. — Foto: REUTERS/Irakli Gedenidze/Arquivo

O presidente da Sérvia, Aleksandar Vučić, dissolveu o Parlamento nesta quarta-feira (9) e convocou novas eleições parlamentares antecipadas para 25 de outubro, atendendo a uma das principais reivindicações do movimento de protestos liderado por estudantes.

As eleições parlamentares estavam previstas para ocorrer apenas em dezembro de 2027, mas Vučić assinou um decreto convocando a votação antecipada após quase dois anos de manifestações contra o governo.

A medida permitirá que Vučić, cujo Partido Progressista Sérvio o indicou no sábado para concorrer ao cargo de primeiro-ministro, tente reafirmar sua autoridade depois que os protestos representaram o maior desafio ao seu governo.

Vučić, que há 12 anos governa o país como presidente ou premiê, enfrenta manifestações anticorrupção desencadeadas pelo desabamento de uma cobertura de concreto em uma estação ferroviária na cidade de Novi Sad, no norte do país, em novembro de 2024, que matou 16 pessoas.

A oposição e os manifestantes acusam Vučić e seus aliados de violência contra adversários políticos, corrupção generalizada, vínculos com o crime organizado e restrições às liberdades de imprensa. Vučić e seus aliados negam todas as acusações.

articles.title: VÍDEO: Temporal com ventos fortes causa estragos em Zé Doca no MA  | G1

articles.summary: Moradores informaram que o fenômeno foi rápido e durou menos de 10 minutos, mas causou prejuízos.
articles.body:
Um temporal atingiu o município de Zé Doca , no interior do Maranhão, no início da noite desta terça-feira (8). Segundo moradores, não houve registro de chuva, mas apenas ventos fortes acompanhados de raios e trovões, que foram suficientes para causar estragos em diferentes pontos do município.

Imagens divulgadas por moradores mostram portões de casas e estabelecimentos derrubados, além de parte do muro do estádio municipal que caiu com a força dos ventos. Apesar dos estragos, não houve registro de feridos. (Veja o vídeo acima) .

Moradores informaram que o fenômeno foi rápido e durou menos de 10 minutos, mas causou prejuízos. Parte do muro que desabou atingiu o carro de um motorista que estava dentro do veículo. Ele conseguiu sair sem ferimentos e teve apenas danos materiais.

O registro chamou atenção dos moradores porque ventos dessa intensidade não são comuns neste período do ano na região. O período de estiagem costuma ocorrer entre o fim de junho e janeiro, mas chuvas isoladas podem ocorrer em alguns meses, como setembro.

O g1 tentou contato com a Prefeitura de Zé Doca para saber quais medidas serão adotadas após o temporal, mas não recebeu retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

articles.title: Troves of new 9/11 docs suggest NYC officials knew of air quality health risks
articles.summary: New York City released about 170,000 pages of documents related to post-9/11 air quality and health risks on Tuesday.
articles.body: New York City released about 170,000 pages of documents related to post-9/11 air quality and health risks on Tuesday — a trove of paperwork within which some notes suggest city officials knew of the potential environmental dangers and legal exposure in the early aftermath of the terror attacks. One undated internal document — a letter to former Mayor Rudy Giuliani’s deputy mayor, Robert Harding — listed various potential grounds for lawsuits against the city, including health advisories that caused people to return to the area too soon, causing toxic exposure, rescue workers being provided with faulty equipment, and police failing to secure businesses from looters. Another memo early in the Michael Bloomberg administration, five months after 9/11, said the city was “leaving itself open to a barrage of lawsuits. At the least, we should discontinue telling people to clean their apartments with wet mops and rags.” The note added that the city should ask the federal government for cleanup funds. NYC Corporation Counsel Steven Banks said that the city’s Department of Investigation is now investigating what city officials knew and when they knew it, as well as why information appears to have been withheld. Meanwhile, city officials continue to comb through millions of additional pages of documents they say the federal World Trade Center insurer, WTC Captive Insurance Co., had in its possession. The city last week settled litigation over public access to the records, including by a group called 9/11 Health Watch. Now, this information is available to the public via a new online portal Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the creation of earlier this year. He allocated up to $34 million this year to operate the database. The documents made public Tuesday include the contents of 68 boxes city officials say were located only recently in a Department of Environmental Protection office. They also contain records the Giuliani administration sent for archival, and documents the city’s law department had related to 7 World Trade Center, the building where Giuliani positioned the city’s emergency “bunker,” and its ultimate collapse. Banks says those 170,000 pages are just the first of “millions” of pages the Mamdani administration is reviewing. They say their goal is to post as many as possible over the next 12 months. Banks said many of the documents were out of the city’s possession for years because they were turned over to the federal insurer that Congress established. He says they were only recently returned. Some of them are redacted to protect personal and security-related information, Banks added. In a statement obtained by NBC New York ahead of the drop, Mamdani says at the “very least,” the city owes transparency and accountability to those whose lives were forever impacted by the 9/11 attacks. “For too long, New Yorkers have had to fight for access to records that should have been available to them in the first place,” Mamdani said. “This portal is part of our administration’s enduring commitment to honor those we lost, care for those living with lasting health consequences, and give thousands of New Yorkers the answers they’ve been asking for.”

articles.title: Odisha: Five baby orangutans found in India forest spark trafficking investigation
articles.summary: The critically endangered apes were found far from their natural habitat in the eastern Indian state of Odisha.
articles.body:
Five baby orangutans have been found in a forest in India's eastern state of Odisha, far from their natural habitat, prompting an investigation into how they got there.

Photographs and videos widely shared online show the young apes sitting together on the forest floor and eating bananas, thousands of kilometres from the tropical rainforests where they belong.

Orangutans are not native to India. The critically endangered apes are found in the wild only in Indonesia and Malaysia.

Odisha's forest minister has said investigators are examining whether the animals were trafficked into the country by an international smuggling network and abandoned near a highway.

The orangutans were rescued early on Tuesday in Balasore district after local people spotted them and alerted forest officials.

They were given first aid before being taken to Nandankanan Zoological Park in the state capital, Bhubaneswar, where they are in quarantine and being monitored.

Balasore District Forest Officer Pratik Prakash Indalkar told the BBC that the animals could not have reached Odisha naturally and may have been transported there by road.

"The five animals were found in Ranakata, a proposed reserve forest in Bhogarai block, near the West Bengal border," he said.

"The area is covered mainly by casuarina trees and is not a dense forest. It is also close to a state highway."

The Odisha government has also reportedly asked India's Wildlife Crime Control Bureau to investigate. Police, forest officials and a special task force are involved in the inquiry.

Forest officials believe the orangutans had been in the area for only two or three days.

A search of the forest found no other orangutans or clues as to how the animals got there, Indalkar said.

Officials described them to the BBC as infants, although some local reports suggest they are between one and two years old.

Their young age makes their discovery particularly concerning, wildlife expert Biswajit Mohanty said.

Young orangutans typically remain with their mothers for several years, learning the skills they need to survive independently. Females also reproduce slowly, usually giving birth only once every eight years.

The discovery of five young orangutans together, thousands of kilometres from their natural habitat and with no adult animals nearby, has therefore raised concerns of how they came to be in Odisha.

There are three known living species of orangutan - Bornean, Sumatran and Tapanuli - all of which are classified as critically endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature, or IUCN.

Over the years, their numbers have declined sharply because of deforestation, habitat loss and hunting.

International commercial trade in orangutans is prohibited under Cites - the global agreement governing trade in endangered wildlife. They are also protected under Indian wildlife laws.

Despite this, orangutans continue to be trafficked for sale as exotic pets and to private collectors.

This is not the first time young orangutans have been found in India.

In 2022, two baby orangutans were found abandoned at a checkpoint near the border between the states of Assam and Mizoram. Officials suspected they had been brought into India through neighbouring Myanmar.

articles.title: Man in court accused of killing two cyclists in Gravesend crash
articles.summary: A man is charged after a car hit three cyclists, killing two and injuring another in Kent.
articles.body:
A man has been appeared in court accused of killing two cyclists and injuring another in a crash in Kent.

Aaron Turner, 22, from St Patrick's Gardens in Gravesend, was bailed after appearing by video link at Medway Magistrates' Court charged with causing death by dangerous driving.

Natasha Lewis, 51, and Stephen Anscombe, 60, died of "traumatic and catastrophic" injuries in the crash near Gravesend on Sunday, and the third cyclist was treated in hospital, the court heard.

Turner is accused of having "lost control" of his white Ford Focus while travelling south-west near the village of Sole Street at about 07:45 BST.

In addition to two counts of causing death by dangerous driving, Turner has been charged with failing to stop at the scene of a crash and possession of a class C drug.

A 21-year-old man who was arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving and a 19-year-old woman who was detained on suspicion of assisting an offender have been released on police bail.

Turner spoke to confirm his name, address and date of birth during Wednesday's court appearance.

He is next due to appear at Woolwich Crown Court on 7 October.

Prosecutor Dylan Bradshaw said the three cyclists had been on a "training cycle ride" prior to a "very long cycle ride" they were planning overseas.

He added that Anscombe left behind his wife and two daughters while Lewis was survived by her 23-year-old daughter, who also lost her father in 2019.

Investigators are asking anyone who saw the car or cyclists before the incident, or who witnessed the crash near the junction of Sole Street and Round Street, to contact them.

They also appealed for members of the public with CCTV or dashcam footage to get in touch.

articles.title: In 1982, Chile imported European bumblebees to pollinate crops; the invaders crossed into Argentina, spread through Patagonia, and pushed its only native bumblebee toward regional extinction
articles.summary: US News: In 1982, Chile introduced European bumblebees for crop pollination, leading to ecological disruption and the decline of the native bombus dahlbomii in Patagonia. This article explores the consequences of this invasion and the urgent need for conservation efforts.
articles.body: What began as a farming fix in central Chile has, over four decades, reshaped pollinator communities across southern South America. Approximately 300 queens of Bombus ruderatus were introduced into central Chile in 1982-1983 from the New Zealand population to increase the yield of red clover seeds. This farming choice led to ecological alterations that are now putting the Bombus dahlbomii at risk of regional extinction. Bombus dahlbomii is the sole bumblebee species native to the area and is one of the biggest bumblebees in the Americas.A second invader spread faster than expectedRed clover depends heavily on long-tongued pollinators, and honey bees have proved inefficient at the task. The species Bombus ruderatus was used because it had already proved successful in New Zealand's red clover fields. The scheme worked: freed from the natural enemies that had limited their numbers in Europe, the bees spread on their own and reached Patagonia, Argentina, by the early 1990s. It would take another fifteen years for Chile's greenhouse tomato industry to introduce a second European species, Bombus terrestris, which itself would take nearly another decade to disperse across the Andes and reach Patagonia.An alien parasite arrived with the invasive bees Carolina Morales, Marina Arbetman, Sydney Cameron and Marcelo Aizen documented the first records of Bombus terrestris in Patagonia, Argentina, in March 2006, after it dispersed over the Andes from Chilean greenhouses, in their 2013 article in Frontiers in Ecology and the Environment, "Rapid Ecological Replacement of a Native Bumblebee by Invasive Species." Their wide survey of Patagonia found that within less than five years of its introduction, B. terrestris had become the most widespread and abundant bumblebee species in the region.Some interesting statistics can be highlighted from this evidence. During the duration of the research, B. ruderatus extended its geographical distribution up to 434 kilometers, while B. terrestris extended up to 1,320 kilometers. This southern extension of its distribution was accompanied by a retreat of B. dahlbomii. In another 20-year study of pollinators visiting the native flower Alstroemeria aurea in northern Patagonia, Aizen and colleagues found that the two exotic species had replaced the native pollinator B. dahlbomii, which had pollinated the flower for generations.The native bumblebee has vanished from parts of its rangeRange expansion alone does not fully explain how quickly the native bee vanished from so many locations. A second line of research points to disease as a compounding factor. The study ‘Alien parasite hitchhikes to Patagonia on invasive bumblebee’ (Arbetman et al., 2013), published in Biological Invasions, tested bumblebees collected before and after the arrival of B. terrestris for the pathogenic protozoan Apicystis bombi.In the absence of the invasion, not a single specimen of B. ruderatus or B. dahlbomii was infected by the parasite. Following the establishment of B. terrestris in the area, the situation drastically altered. Nearly one in two B. terrestris specimens tested positive for the parasite, as did just over one in two B. ruderatus specimens and about one in nine B. dahlbomii specimens. The genetic analysis revealed that the parasite belonged to the European lineage, which means that the parasite had most probably been brought in alongside the commercial bees. As noted in the study discussed above, this was the first recorded instance of Apicystis bombi infecting B. ruderatus or B. dahlbomii in the whole world.Researchers are testing acoustic monitoring to track survivors This combination of factors that are competition, the accelerated colony turnover rate of the invader and spillover pathogens has been very costly. Species B. dahlbomii has gone extinct in certain areas it used to inhabit, such as some portions of the Challhuaco Valley that scientists had been monitoring for decades. According to the information provided by the IUCN species account, this bee has not been classified in terms of its inclusion in the IUCN Red List yet. This example demonstrates the necessity of implementing regulations concerning non-indigenous pollinators. The article by Morales et al. states quite directly what this particular case study implies for future actions in other places: given how rapidly an invasive bumble bee displaces its native congener, introducing non-indigenous pollinators in areas inhabited by endangered bee species should be done much more carefully than was done in Chile in 1982.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Norway bids final farewell to King Harald V with funeral attended by royalty and dignitaries
articles.summary: Norway will bid its final farewell to King Harald V on with a funeral attended by royalty and leaders from across Europe.
articles.body: Norway will bid its final farewell to King Harald V on Wednesday with a funeral attended by royalty and leaders from across Europe and beyond, who will pay tribute to the popular monarch’s 35-year reign. Harald, who died on Aug. 28 aged 89, was Europe’s oldest monarch and had modernized the royal house, but refused to follow in the footsteps of other aging monarchs who have abdicated in recent times. His son immediately became King Haakon VIII and last week pledged an oath of allegiance to Norway’s constitution in parliament. On Wednesday, the coffin will be taken from the royal palace to Oslo Cathedral in a procession, followed by Haakon, other senior Norwegian royals, foreign guests and representatives of Norway’s parliament and others. Ahead of the funeral, Norwegians have waited patiently to file past Harald’s coffin as it lay in state in the chapel of the royal palace in Oslo. The queue was seven hours long at one point over the weekend. Over 46,000 people visited the chapel during the week. Large crowds are expected in the capital for the funeral. The downtown area will be closed to vehicles and electric scooters, and police have instructed people not to bring bicycles, umbrellas or sharp objects. Large screens have been set up for people to watch the ceremony. Among the guests expected to attend are the monarchs of Sweden, Denmark, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium and Jordan. The heir to the British throne, Prince William, is also expected, as is Crown Prince Akishino of Japan. Presidents from a range of European countries will join them. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is among those attending the funeral. On Tuesday, he met with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre in Oslo to discuss the war in Ukraine. The United States will be represented by Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs Allison Hooker. A minute’s silence will be held across Norway at the start of the funeral ceremony. Eulogies will be delivered by Norway’s parliament speaker and prime minister, and there will be a candlelighting ceremony with representatives of different faiths. After the funeral, Harald’s coffin will be taken in a procession to the palace chapel at Akershus Castle, where the late king’s ancestors are buried. After a private ceremony for the Norwegian royals, who will be joined by some of the foreign guests and senior Norwegian officials, it will be lowered into the crypt. Norway’s monarchy traces its origins to King Harald Fairhair in the ninth century. When Norway regained its independence from Sweden in 1905, three-quarters of voters in a national plebiscite approved restoring the monarchy. Today, the throne’s role is largely symbolic and power lies with the elected government and parliament, but the Norwegian royal family retains a role in promoting the wealthy Scandinavian nation around the world.

articles.title: In 2013, scientists released 11 kg of red dye into Lake Michigan to measure offshore mixing; the study recorded dispersion rising from 1.5 to 4.2 m²/s over about 21 hours
articles.summary: US News: Discover how a 2013 dye release experiment by Purdue University scientists uncovered surprising turbulent mixing patterns in Lake Michigan, challenging previous assumptions about the lake's interior dynamics and implications for environmental management.
articles.body: Stretching more than 500 kilometres and bordered by Wisconsin, Michigan, Illinois and Indiana, Lake Michigan is the only one of the five Great Lakes entirely contained within the United States. The lake frequently appears leisurely to anyone standing at its edge, rippling softly in the breeze with minimal drama beneath. Researchers knew that currents inside large lakes could transport heat, nutrients and pollutants, but offshore dispersion in lakes this large had rarely been measured directly.But to prove it, one had to figure out how to see water move in a way that was invisible to the human eye. And that’s precisely what a team of Purdue University engineers, working with NOAA’s Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory, set out to do in the summer of 2013. They took eleven kilogrammes of Rhodamine WT, a fluorescent tracer that turns water a detectable pink-red, out to the heart of the lake’s southern basin on the research vessel Blue Heron. Their work was later published in the journal Limnology and Oceanography, where the researchers explained that they wanted to measure something notoriously difficult to pin down, namely how quickly and how far a patch of water spreads once it enters the open lake well away from any shore.A cloud takes shape offshoreThe dye was diluted in ethanol and lake water to the density of the surrounding surface layer and pumped through a floating diffuser over several minutes so that it would diffuse uniformly rather than sink or coalesce. Within hours, the pink patch had expanded from a tight cloud to a large, uneven smear on the water, visible from the boat and later mapped in detail with fluorometers towed behind survey vessels. The crew tracked the plume for roughly a day, seeing its edges stretch and fold as it travelled with the surface currents of the lake.But what they actually wanted was a figure called the dispersion coefficient, which tells you how rapidly a blob of fluid spreads out over time. Friction from the lake bottom and the shoreline tends to stretch and shear a dye patch rapidly in coastal waters. Scientists had typically expected mixing to be gentler and slower far offshore, in deep open water, because there is no nearby boundary to perturb the flow. That assumption was part of why the experiment was important: testing it required measuring dispersion in the open heart of a large lake rather than near its boundaries.What the spreading rate revealedThe team was surprised by the result. Over roughly 21 hours, the team observed the dye patch's dispersion rate rise from about 1.5 to 4.2 square metres per second. That is a rapid spreading rate for water so far from any shoreline, and it pointed to a process the researchers had not expected to dominate the open lake. The researchers found that near-surface shear induced by near-inertial Poincaré waves partially explained the elevated dye dispersion rates observed during the experiment, which ripple through the boundary between warm surface water and the colder layer beneath it during summer stratification.The Poincaré waves themselves are internal motions associated with the lake's stratified water column, but the researchers linked them to vertical shear that extends through the mixed layer. That shear can cause different layers of the water to move at different speeds, helping stretch and spread the dye patch. Dye included. As a second, longer experiment, the scientists also launched floating drifters that lasted twenty-four days and exhibited more placid, more progressive dispersal in still conditions before turning to a speedier, patchier pattern when the winds kicked up.Why hidden mixing mattersKnowing how quickly water is stirred up in the open lake has implications far beyond scientific interest. It matters for predicting how toxins will move after a spill, what happens to nutrients from agricultural runoff in deep water, and how heat from a warming climate is distributed through the lake over a season. Earlier studies of nearshore waters had already shown that mixing can be brisk near the coast because of wave action and bottom friction. The 2013 dye release showed that the lake's seemingly tranquil interior can, under the right conditions, mix almost as vigorously, but for different physical reasons. That finding challenges a core assumption about the vastness and widespread use of Lake Michigan.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: In 1971, scientists moved 10 insect-eating lizards to Croatia’s Pod Mrcaru islet; when they returned in 2004, more than 5,000 descendants showed larger heads and altered digestive systems for a plant-rich diet
articles.summary: Rest of World News: In a remarkable study of evolution, scientists observed how ten Italian wall lizards introduced to a Croatian island evolved into over 5,000 descendants with larger heads and plant-digesting guts in just over three decades. This groundbreaking research sheds light on rapid evolutionary changes in isolated environments.
articles.body: Off the Dalmatian coast, the Adriatic Sea is dotted with small, usually deserted islets, many of which are bare rock and brush too small to show up on standard maps. Pod Kopiste and Pod Mrcaru are two of these landmasses that are located close to the bigger island of Lastovo, only a few km apart. Other than the lizards that crawled across its limestone, they received very little attention for decades. The landscape was altered by a little experiment conducted by biologist Eviatar Nevo and his associates, which turned out to be one of the clearest real-time examples of evolution in a vertebrate species documented so far.In 1971, ten Italian wall lizards (five males and five females) were removed from Pod Kopiste and introduced to the nearby islet of Pod Mrcaru by researchers. The experiment was just to observe how two similar animals may compete if placed together on a limited plot of land. The resident lizard population of a related species, the Dalmatian wall lizard, already existed on Pod Mrcaru. It was a purposefully low-key study, the kind of thing that may have been forgotten once the islands became unreachable because of conflict.An island left undisturbed for decadesFor years, access to the area was blocked by political unrest and the Croatian War of Independence, making it impossible for researchers to monitor the lizards they had brought in. Scientists weren't able to visit Pod Mrcaru again until 2004, when conditions permitted travel to resume. Since a population founded by only ten lizards would be vulnerable to disappearing on a small island, nobody involved expected to find the population thriving when researchers returned.Instead, the team found the islet teeming with lizards. Genetic testing confirmed that the more than five thousand lizards now living on Pod Mrcaru were all descendants of those original ten animals and that the native Dalmatian wall lizards they had been introduced alongside, they had disappeared from the island entirely. The Italian wall lizards had not only survived for more than three decades but had also developed marked differences from the source population on Pod Kopište.New heads, new bite, new gutIn comparison to the source population, the Pod Mrcaru lizards' bite force had significantly risen, and their skulls had become markedly larger in relation to their body size. A detailed anatomical study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences found pronounced differences in head morphology and bite force between the Pod Mrčaru and Pod Kopište populations. In the article, led by biologist Anthony Herrel, the alterations were described as an example of evolution occurring rapidly enough to be observed within one human lifetime.But the biggest revelation was an inner discovery. Its lizards had a diet significantly richer in plant material than the primarily insect-based menu on Pod Kopiste, and the animals had altered their digestive systems to match. Dissections revealed that the lizards had evolved cecal valves, muscular structures between the small and large intestines that restrict the transit of food and give bacteria more time to break down tough plant fibre into consumable nutrients. Such structures are widespread in plant-eating lizards, but researchers had not previously observed them evolving from scratch within a population in such a short time.A textbook case with lasting influenceSince then, the Pod Mrcaru lizards have become a touchstone in evolutionary biology, often cited as evidence that natural selection can act quickly when a population enters a new environment. Later studies have also examined differences in the gut microbiome and digestive physiology between the Pod Mrčaru and Pod Kopište population. What started as an off-hand experiment in competition between two species of lizard developed, seemingly by chance, into a unique, unbroken observation of evolution happening under real settings. The conflict kept researchers away from the islet for decades, leaving the introduced population without regular scientific monitoring while it adapted to its new environment.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Learner drivers still forced to wait months to book tests
articles.summary: The Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency had been given a target to reduce average wait times to seven weeks.
articles.body:
Learner drivers have to wait an average 20 weeks, or around five months, before booking a practical test, according to new figures, despite attempts to reduce delays.

The data from the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA) for August is only a marginal improvement from 20.2 weeks in July.

The average wait time between booking and sitting a test is unchanged at 11.1 weeks.

The DVSA initially had a target of reducing the average waiting time to seven weeks by the end of last year. Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander pushed the target back to summer 2026, but subsequently admitted even that would not be possible.

The DVSA made a number of changes to its practical driving test booking system earlier this year.

Only the learner driver themself is now able to book their driving test, blocking an instructor or third parties from booking using the learner's details.

There is also a geographical restriction which means a learner can only book a test at their three local test centres, rather than one at the other side of the country if they found a test available.

The number of times a would-be driver can swap a test date has also been restricted.

Lucy Rend is 19 and lives in south east London and has been learning to drive for two-and-a-half years. She has a driving test on Thursday and feels under pressure to pass because getting a slot has been so difficult.

It meant getting up at 5.45am everyday to get on the DVSA for 6am. "Then I'd be 21,000 in the queue," she said. "It was very hard but randomly one popped up."

Rend: "I feel lots of pressure to pass because if I don't pass I will have to go through all that again and try find another test, so would rather pass this one and then it is done."

Her friends are also struggling to book a test and "most of them have given up and not going to bother anymore".

The DVSA said on Wednesday that more than 2.13 million practical driving tests took place in the 12 months to August 2026 – the highest rolling 12-month figure on record.

DVSA chief executive Beverley Warmington, said: "There's more to do and we're not going to stop until every learner can get a fair test slot when they need one but today's figures show our plan is working."

Carly Brookfield, the chief executive of the Driving Instructors Association, said the higher number of available tests was "progress that should be recognised" but, for learners and instructors "the pressure is still very real".

"The ultimate measure of recovery has to be a testing service that learners and the professional training community can access when they need it," she said.

Adem Veli, who has been an instructor for 16 years and runs his driving school Passman in Sidcup, said: "Before Covid we had the luxury we could pick the test date and work towards that date."

But he said learners having to wait so long can have a huge impact on their confidence.

"It's about a six month wait," he said. "Can you imagine if you did fail your driving test, you're test standard and ready to go [but] have to wait another six months to get back in?"

DVSA figures revealed that the pass rate for driving tests remains over 50%.

Veli said that some of the changes the DVSA has made have been positive, such as limiting the number of swaps a learner can make.

However, while the DVSA has made changes to stop third parties booking tests, Veli said: "I get messages weekly, they're trying to sell them to me.

"I've had students ask me about this site or that site, but I tell them don't bother with it now as there's so many scams."

articles.title: 'Lies made in Haaretz': Netanyahu sues Israeli newspaper over 'fabricated' UAE warning report
articles.summary: Middle East News: NEW DELHI: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has instructed his lawyers to file a libel lawsuit against left-wing newspaper Haaretz, journalis.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has instructed his lawyers to file a libel lawsuit against left-wing newspaper Haaretz, journalist Shlomi Eldar and other parties over what he described as a fabricated report claiming that the United Arab Emirates warned him about a possible Hamas attack before October 7.Netanyahu shared a letter detailing the planned lawsuit in a post on X, accusing Haaretz and Eldar of publishing a false account of a conversation that, he said, never took place.In a letter titled "Lies Made in "Haaretz"", Netanyahu said the alleged conversation between him and the President of the United Arab Emirates did not take place between the beginning of September and October 7.The letter said: "Contrary to the claims, from the beginning of September until October 7, no conversation took place between the Prime Minister and the President of the United Arab Emirates.The Prime Minister's Office, the National Security Council, and the Military Secretary meticulously reviewed the Prime Minister's call log for those days—and found no trace of it whatsoever.In general, the diplomatic conversations between the Prime Minister and the Emirati President take place exclusively through the Prime Minister's Office via the Emirati representative who arrives at the office with a special encrypted device.All these conversations are documented.Eldar himself said last night in an interview on Channel 12 that the conversation he claims took place, in which he claimed a warning was given to the Prime Minister, was conducted in this manner.However, a thorough investigation conducted not only in the Prime Minister's call log but also in the records of entries to the Prime Minister's Office during that period shows no entry of the Emirati representative to the Prime Minister's Office.There is no possibility of entering the Prime Minister's Office without documentation and recording by the security forces at the facility.Eldar also lied when he said that Egypt warned the Prime Minister of a possible attack—a claim that was already debunked at the beginning of the war.All this proves that we are dealing with a malicious fabrication with a clear political timing, as part of the left's election campaign, and there will be more such false stories.This fabrication was intended to distract from what the public already understands:Ronen Bar and Herzi Halevi saw all the signs indicating many hours before the start of the attack.
